name: Pillow Fort War
hook: Build a pillow fort. Then pillow fight for the flag.
how: Two teams pile cushions into forts on their side of the living room, then the pillow fight starts: lob pillows over the forts, bonk the other team, grab their flag and carry it home. Get bonked while carrying it and you drop it.
controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and click to throw, click to place cushions; on phones, left thumb moves and drag on the right to aim and throw
uses: The host's browser keeps the forts and the flags; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Every pillow, cushion and kid moves for everyone at once.
Bots build forts and join the fight until enough people join.
Pillow points: 5 per flag captured and 1 per bonk.
ideas: Add a giant beanbag that bounces pillows back
Let each kid carry three pillows and pick them up from the floor
Turn the lights off so you only see near your flashlight
